name: iso-42001
title: ISO/IEC 42001 readiness
note: Control mappings are the author's reading of each provision, written to make engineering readiness checkable. They are not legal advice and do not decide what a regulation requires of you. Check the text and your counsel, and edit this file to match their view.

controls.title: AI policy approved
controls.remedy: Approve an AI policy that matches the organisation's objectives and review it.

controls.title: Roles and accountability
controls.remedy: Define and allocate AI roles and responsibilities, and a way to report concerns.

controls.title: Resources for the AI system documented
controls.remedy: Document the data, tooling, compute and human resources the system relies on.

controls.title: AI system impact assessment
controls.remedy: Assess the impacts of the system on individuals, groups and society and keep the results.

controls.title: Life cycle processes defined
controls.remedy: Define the processes for design, verification, deployment, operation and retirement.

controls.title: Data for AI systems managed
controls.remedy: Document data provenance, quality and preparation.

controls.title: Information for interested parties
controls.remedy: Give users and other interested parties the information they need to use the system and understand its limits.

controls.title: Responsible use defined
controls.remedy: Define the processes and objectives for responsible use of the system.

controls.title: Third-party and customer relationships
controls.remedy: Allocate responsibilities with suppliers and customers and assess the risks they bring.

controls.title: Internal audit of the management system
controls.remedy: Audit the management system at planned intervals and record findings and actions.
